author: The Current
description:
Songwriter, guitarist, and producer Cory Wong talked with The Current’s Morning Show about his album ‘On A Random Tuesday (Live at The Blue Note) featuring Joshua Redman’ and the significance of the venue.

Read and listen to the full interview at thecurrent.org 🎸
